COMPUTER STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Computer set up, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer set up.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer set up.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer set up.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer set up.

2. When learning Operating System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Operating System.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System.

3. When learning Computer storage, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage.

4. When learning Input/Output Devices, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Input/Output Devices.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Input/Output Devices.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Input/Output Devices.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Input/Output Devices.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

6. When learning Evolution and Development of Computers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution and Development of Computers.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Evolution and Development of Computers.

7. When learning Data Transmission Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Transmission Media.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Data Transmission Media.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Transmission Media.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Transmission Media.

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Run with the tool

9. When learning Central Processing Unit, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Central Processing Unit.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Central Processing Unit.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Central Processing Unit.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Central Processing Unit.

10. When learning Data communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Data communication.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

12. When learning Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.

13. When learning Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.

14. When learning Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.

15. When learning Computer Organisation and Architecture, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Organisation and Architecture.

16. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
